title: A Curved-Path Refinement of the Kalai--Kleitman Diameter Bound
summary: Let $Δ_u(d,n)$ be the maximum graph diameter of a pointed $d$-dimensional polyhedron with $n$ facets. Using a curved-path encoding of the iterated Kalai--Kleitman recurrence, we prove, uniformly over $n\geq d\geq 4$, \[ Δ_u(d,n) \leq (n-d)^{\log_2 G_d},\qquad G_d = (4\ln 2+o(1))\frac{d}{(\ln d)^2}, \] where the asymptotic expression for $G_d$ is understood as $d\to\infty$, improving the exponent of the previous best quasi-polynomial bound by an additional logarithmic factor.
